metadata.selection_method: Selected WBD HUC-8 units are dissolved into four research-defined operational basins; point assignments are computed from these polygons.
metadata.historical_limit: These are modern hydrologic boundaries. Santee and Cooper geometry reflects the twentieth-century Santee–Cooper diversion and impoundments and must be interpreted alongside historical cartography.

properties.scope: Cross Creek–Moore’s Creek–Guilford Courthouse comparison area, including the Haw, Deep, upper and lower Cape Fear, Black, and Northeast Cape Fear subbasins.
properties.historical_note: Modern terrain-based watershed boundary used as a geographic framework; it is not an eighteenth-century administrative boundary.
properties.source_names: Haw|Deep|Upper Cape Fear|Lower Cape Fear|Black|Northeast Cape Fear

properties.scope: Yadkin–Pee Dee and Winyah Bay system: Wachovia and Salisbury through Cheraws, Lynches, Kingstree, Black Mingo, Snow’s Island, and Georgetown.
properties.historical_note: Modern terrain-based watershed boundary used as a geographic framework; it is not an eighteenth-century administrative boundary.

properties.scope: Catawba–Wateree–Santee system: upper Catawba and Broad headwaters through Camden, the Congaree, Nelson’s Ferry, and the lower Santee.
